title: Spec 014 mounted Tenant shared-operation-state and failure/retry proof

phases.objective: Prove that one mounted Tenant request resolves Context Kernel authority and uses one canonical repository instance for the exact successful operation through immutable-plan consumption, prepared/result/readback journaling, reconciliation, and Tenant-safe readback; separately execute the canonical synthetic unknown-outcome contract to prove failure classification, reconcile-before-retry, replay safety, and conflict blocking.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact successful Tenant operation completes in the same repository instance with consumed immutable plan, prepared/result/readback journal, reconciliation result, and Tenant-safe readback bindings; a separately attributable synthetic executor contract proves the required failure/retry safety path.
steps: Create one Tenant operation with its immutable plan, approval evidence, execution lease, adapter, one-shot enablement, and canonical in-memory repository.
Mount the Tenant route with Context Kernel and effective-authority resolution bound to that exact operation.
Submit one expected-SHA-bound Tenant request to the mounted apply-plan endpoint.
Read the exact successful operation back from the same repository object supplied to the runtime.
Require completed operation state, consumed immutable plan with unchanged bindings, unchanged append-only approvals, and prepared/result/readback journal phases for the same run and plan.
Require one reconciliation record and bind the Tenant-safe response to the same operation, run, plan, outcome, and result digest.

Execute the canonical synthetic unknown-outcome contract as a separate child fixture and require crash-before-mutation reconciliation to not_applied, crash-after-mutation recovery from receipt, replay-safe reconciliation commit, automatic retry denial before readback, and conflict blocking.
Keep provider dispatch, live mutation, migration Apply, schema verification, deployment, Production readiness, and secrets disabled.
assertions: The mounted successful request and post-request readback use the same repository object and operation ID.
The immutable plan bindings remain unchanged while its single-use consumed state advances.
Approval record digests remain append-only and unchanged.
Prepared, result, and readback journal records persist for the same successful operation, run, and plan.
One reconciliation result matches the Tenant-safe response outcome and result digest.
The separately attributable unknown-outcome child contract proves read-before-retry, no blind automatic retry, restart/replay-safe reconciliation, and conflict blocking.
Cross-Tenant requests, request-side authority injection, and expected-SHA drift fail before mutation.
Provider dispatch, live mutation, migration Apply, schema verification, Production readiness, and secrets remain false.

phases.objective: Preserve the MVP evidence while adding mounted cancellation, lease release, approval revocation, and separately authorized new-plan retry coverage.
Extend the mounted shared-state operation itself with route-level fault injection, worker/process restart recovery, checkpoint restoration, and durable-runtime unknown-outcome reconciliation.
Run the same journey against one separately authorized non-production Tenant target after repository-only MVP promotion.
This bounded synthetic-runtime proof grants no live provider, migration, deployment, or Production authority.
